strings.name: Ron Rivest
strings.summary: Ron Rivest co-invented RSA with Adi Shamir and Leonard Adleman, providing a practical approach to public-key encryption and digital signatures. At MIT he studied algorithms, cryptographic design and information security, and co-authored Introduction to Algorithms. He later applied security engineering to voting, verifiable counting and post-election audits, emphasizing public scrutiny of technical systems.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2026. This is not a daily news archive. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-invented the RSA public-key encryption algorithm and advanced cryptography, making foundational contributions to Internet security and electronic transactions.

strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Yale mathematics bachelor's (1969); Stanford computer-science PhD (1974)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Co-inventor of RSA
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Developed RSA with Shamir and Adleman, advancing public-key encryption and digital signatures.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Algorithms and voting security
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Co-authored Introduction to Algorithms and researched verifiable voting and statistical audits.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Signed internet-voting statement
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Joined election-security researchers in a statement on malware, server and verifiability risks in internet voting.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Voting standards work
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Joined technical-guidelines work advising the US Election Assistance Commission on certification, security and transparency.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Shared Turing Award
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Received the award with Shamir and Adleman for public-key cryptography.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Introduction to Algorithms
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Published the first edition with Thomas Cormen and Charles Leiserson, presenting algorithm design and analysis.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Co-founded RSA Data Security
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Helped establish the company connecting cryptographic research with commercial software.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Published RSA paper
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Published a method for public-key cryptosystems and digital signatures with Shamir and Adleman.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: PhD and MIT faculty
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Earned his Stanford doctorate and joined MIT's faculty that year.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Yale mathematics degree
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Completed undergraduate mathematics at Yale before computer-science research.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in New York state
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Born in Schenectady and grew up in nearby Niskayuna.
